[[diagnostics]]
== Diagnostic codes

Every finding the processor can report, with what it means. This
section is generated by `scripts/sync-diagnostics.mjs` from
`src/constants/diagnostics.ts`, and the test suite holds the two
equal to the codes the source actually emits -- in both directions,
so a code cannot be documented without existing and cannot exist
without being documented.

Severity is as emitted. A handful of codes are raised at more than
one severity depending on which check reaches them first; those list
each, most serious first.

133 codes.

=== Lexing and parsing

[cols="2,1,4", options="header"]
|===
| Code | Severity | Meaning

| `DUPLICATE_KEY` | error | One key written twice in a block, where the second would silently win.
| `EXPECTED_IDENT` | error | An identifier was required here -- a block id, or a key.
| `EXPECTED_KEYWORD` | error | A keyword from a closed set was required and the word given is not in it.
| `EXPECTED_LBRACE` | error | A block was expected to open with `{`.
| `EXPECTED_NUMBER` | error | A number was required and the value given is not one.
| `EXPECTED_TOKEN` | error | A specific token was required here and something else was found.
| `EXPECTED_TOP_LEVEL` | error | A top-level block was expected at this point in the file.
| `MISSING_VALUE` | error | A key was written with `=` and no value after it.
| `NESTED_BLOCK_SCOPED` | error | A block appears inside another that does not contain it.
| `TOPLEVEL_PARSE` | error | A top-level block could not be parsed; its contents are skipped.
| `UNEXPECTED_CHARACTER` | error | A character the lexer does not recognise anywhere in the language.
| `UNKNOWN_TOP_LEVEL` | error | A top-level block whose keyword the language does not have.
| `UNTERMINATED_BLOCK_COMMENT` | error | A `/* ... */` comment reaches the end of the file without closing.
| `UNTERMINATED_STRING` | error | A quoted string reaches the end of the line without closing.
|===

=== Keys and values

[cols="2,1,4", options="header"]
|===
| Code | Severity | Meaning

| `PAGE_VALUE_UNKNOWN` | error | A `page` styling value outside the set that key accepts.
| `REMOVED_KEY` | error | A key that has been removed; the message says what it was and what to do instead.
| `RENAMED_KEY` | error | A key that has been renamed; the message names the current spelling.
| `UNIT_MISSING` | error | A physical quantity written as a bare number; no key carries its own unit.
| `UNIT_UNKNOWN` | error | A unit suffix the language does not recognise, such as `KA` for `kA`.
| `UNIT_WRONG_QUANTITY` | error | A real unit of the wrong kind, such as a time suffix on a current.
| `UNKNOWN_KEY` | warning | A key that means something elsewhere in the language, written in the wrong block.
| `UNKNOWN_SETTING` | error | A key the block does not accept, in a block where every key changes a number.
| `VALUE_UNKNOWN` | error | A value outside the closed set the key accepts.
|===

=== System, voltages and transformers

[cols="2,1,4", options="header"]
|===
| Code | Severity | Meaning

| `REFERRAL_NEEDS_CONNECTION` | error | An unbalanced fault carried across a transformer whose windings do not settle how.
| `VECTOR_GROUP_MISSING` | error | A declared transformer with no `vector_group`, which is what settles a referral.
| `VECTOR_GROUP_UNREADABLE` | error | A `vector_group` string that cannot be read in full, such as `Dyn11 (assumed)`.
| `VOLTAGE_LEVEL_INVALID` | error | A declared voltage level whose magnitude is not a positive number.
| `VOLTAGE_RATIO_UNRESOLVED` | error | Two levels a current has to cross, with no ratio derivable between them.
| `VOLTAGE_UNKNOWN` | error | A reference to a voltage level `system.voltages` does not declare.
|===

=== Relays, elements and stages

[cols="2,1,4", options="header"]
|===
| Code | Severity | Meaning

| `CT_RATIO_INVALID` | error | A `ct_ratio` that is not a positive ratio.
| `CT_RATIO_MISSING` | error | A setting in secondary amps on a relay with no `ct_ratio` to convert it.
| `CT_SPREAD_WIDE` | warning | CT ratios on one sheet differing by more than 5:1, which a secondary axis cannot serve.
| `CURRENT_PCT_OUT_OF_RANGE` | error | A `share` outside `(0, 100]`.
| `CURVE_STYLE_INVALID` | error | A per-curve `style` outside solid, dashed and dotted.
| `CURVE_UNKNOWN` | error | A `curve` id not in the constants table; the message suggests the closest.
| `CURVE_WIDTH_INVALID` | error | A per-curve `width_px` that is not a positive number.
| `DEFINITE_NO_DELAY` | warning | A definite-time stage with no `t_delay`, which draws as instantaneous.
| `DEFINITE_WITH_TMS` | error | A `tms` on a definite-time stage, whose time does not scale.
| `DUPLICATE_ELEMENT` | error | Two elements of one relay sharing an id.
| `ELEMENT_EMPTY_STAGES` | error | A `stages` block with no stages in it.
| `ELEMENT_MIXED_FORMS` | error | An element carrying both the shorthand curve form and a `stages` block.
| `ELEMENT_NO_CURVE` | error | An element with no curve producer: no `curve`, `formula`, `flex_points` or stages.
| `FLEX_NOT_MONOTONE` | error | A piecewise table with two times at one current, leaving the curve undefined there.
| `FLEX_TIME_NOT_POSITIVE` | warning | A piecewise table point whose time is zero or negative.
| `FLEX_TOO_FEW_POINTS` | error | A piecewise table with fewer than two points, which defines no curve.
| `FORMULA_ALPHA_INVALID` | error | A user formula whose `alpha` is not positive.
| `FORMULA_C_INVALID` | error | A user formula whose `c` is negative.
| `FORMULA_K_INVALID` | error | A user formula whose `k` is not positive.
| `MEASURES_MIXED` | error | Stages of one element measuring different currents, so it is not one characteristic.
| `MEASURES_REQUIRED` | error | A sequence element that does not say which current its pickup is in.
| `MEASURES_UNKNOWN` | error | A `measures` value that is not one of the quantities.
| `PICKUP_MISSING` | error | A stage with no `I_pickup`, so it has no multiple to evaluate.
| `PICKUP_NOT_POSITIVE` | error | An `I_pickup` that is zero or negative.
| `PICKUP_TOO_LOW_FOR_VOLTAGE` | warning | A pickup so far below the level current that a unit error is the likely cause.
| `RELAY_VOLTAGE_UNSPECIFIED` | warning | A relay with no `voltage` in a study that declares more than one level.
| `SHARE_DECLARED_TWICE` | warning | A share stated both on the element and by a scenario, where the scenario wins.
| `STAGE_NO_CURVE` | error | A stage with no curve producer of its own and none to inherit.
| `TMS_MISSING` | error | A dependent-time curve with no multiplier, which is never defaulted to 1.
| `TMS_OUT_OF_RANGE` | error | A multiplier outside the range of the dial that curve is set in.
| `ZERO_DELAY_NOT_PLOTTABLE` | warning | A `t_delay` of zero, which has no position on a logarithmic time axis.

=== Faults, scenarios and points

[cols="2,1,4", options="header"]
|===
| Code | Severity | Meaning

| `DUPLICATE_FAULT` | error | Two faults sharing an id, where the later would silently replace the earlier.
| `DUPLICATE_POINT` | error | Two marked points sharing an id.
| `DUPLICATE_SCENARIO` | error | Two scenarios sharing an id.
| `DUPLICATE_TIME` | error | Two required-clearance entries sharing an id.
| `FAULT_CURRENT_INVALID` | error | A declared fault current that is not finite and positive.
| `FAULT_RANGE_INVERTED` | error | A fault whose minimum is above its maximum.
| `FAULT_SINGLE_POINT` | info | A fault stating one current, so its range endpoints default to it.
| `FAULT_VOLTAGE_UNSPECIFIED` | error | A fault with no voltage level in a study that declares several.
| `POINT_CURRENT_AND_CONDITION` | error | A marked point stating its own current and naming a condition; they are alternatives.
| `POINT_CURRENT_INVALID` | error | A marked point with no current, or one that is not positive.
| `POINT_TIME_INVALID` | error | A marked point whose time is not positive.
| `RANGE_INCOMPLETE` | error | One end of a component range declared without the other.
| `RANGE_WITHOUT_CENTRE` | error | A component range declared with no centre value, so the two come from different sources.
| `SCENARIO_LEVEL_MISSING` | error | A scenario that says nothing at the level a graded relay sits on.
| `SCENARIO_NO_LEVELS` | error | A scenario with no `level` block, so no relay can be evaluated against it.
| `SEQUENCE_ACROSS_LEVELS` | error | A zero-sequence quantity that would have to cross a transformer that blocks it.
| `SEQUENCE_DATA_MISSING` | error | An element measures a component the condition neither declares nor has a type to derive.
| `SEQUENCE_RESIDUAL_CONFLICT` | error | A condition declaring both `I0` and `residual` where the residual is not three times `I0`.
| `TIME_INVALID` | error | A required-clearance entry whose time is not positive.

=== Grading and the solver

[cols="2,1,4", options="header"]
|===
| Code | Severity | Meaning

| `DUPLICATE_GRADE` | error | The same primary and backup graded twice at the same condition.
| `FAULT_OPTIONAL_NO_GRADE_CHECK` | warning | A grade with no condition: the curves render but no margin is computed.
| `GRADE_BEYOND_CUTOFF` | error | A margin asked for past the current where one side's curve stops.
| `GRADE_FAULT_AND_SCENARIO` | error | A grade naming both a `fault` and a `scenario`; they are alternatives.
| `GRADE_MISSING_SIDE` | error | A grade naming only one of its two sides.
| `GRADE_MIXED_QUANTITY` | warning | A pair whose two sides measure different currents at the same condition.
| `GRADE_ON_COMBINE` | error | A grade naming a synthetic `combine` curve, which is not a relay.
| `GRADE_SELF_PAIR` | error | A grade whose primary and backup are the same element.
| `MARGIN_BELOW_CTI` | error | A `margin_target` below the `margin` floor it is supposed to clear.
| `MARGIN_FROM_DERIVED_COMPONENT` | warning | A margin resting on a component derived from an assumed fault shape.
| `MARGIN_NO_SOLVE` | warning | A `margin_target` with no `solve` block, so it is reported as a target only.
| `MULTISTAGE_MULTIVAR_SOLVE` | warning | Two free variables on a multi-stage backup, which v1 does not solve.
| `NO_OPERATION` | warning | Neither side operates at the condition given, so there is no margin.
| `SOLVE_FREE_UNKNOWN` | error | A `free` variable the solver cannot vary.
| `SOLVE_OVERRODE_SETTING` | warning | A solved dial replacing one declared in the file; the sheet is drawn at the solved value.
| `SOLVE_SUPERSEDED` | warning | Another grade's constraint on the same stage demanded more and set the dial.
| `SOLVE_WITHOUT_TARGET` | error | A `solve` block with neither `margin_target` nor `margin` to aim at.
| `SOLVER_NO_IDMT_STAGE` | warning | The controlling stage is definite-time and has no multiplier to turn.
| `SOLVER_NO_PRIMARY_OPERATION` | warning | The primary does not operate at the fault, so there is nothing to grade against.
| `SOLVER_NO_TARGET` | warning | The solver was given no finite margin to aim at.
| `SOLVER_READONLY_DEVICE` | warning | The backup is a device, whose published curve is not adjustable.
| `SOLVER_UNSATISFIABLE` | warning | The target needs a dial outside the settable range; the report says how far.
| `TOLERANCE_OUT_OF_RANGE` | error | A `tolerance_pct` outside a sensible band.
| `UPSTREAM_DISABLED_WITH_CEILING` | warning | An `upstream_to` ceiling on a pair whose sweep is switched off.
| `UPSTREAM_RANGE_EMPTY` | warning | An upstream sweep whose ceiling is not above the declared fault.
| `UPSTREAM_TO_INVALID` | error | An `upstream_to` ceiling that is not a positive current.
| `UPSTREAM_WITHOUT_CTI` | warning | An upstream sweep with no margin constraint for it to check against.
